metadata.name: GeneratedSecretKey
metadata.description: Secret key material of an exact length, in the encoding a library decodes — base64url, padded base64url, base64 or lowercase hex — for signing, encryption or session cookies. Derived from the host's one secret seed, so it is stable across restarts and never stored; an operator may supply it instead.

key.description: The key: exactly `bytes` bytes, written in `encoding`'s canonical text.

bytes.description: How many bytes of key material, 16 to 1024.

encoding.description: How the bytes are written: `base64url` unpadded, `base64url-padded`, `base64` (RFC 4648 §4, padded) or `hex` (lowercase).
